tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol 'debs gcig bzhugs// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol 'debs gcig bzhugs// na mo mañju nā thā ya/ sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// zag med gnyis spangs dril bu pa// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// thabs shes gnyis med ḍā+eṃ ki pa// thabs lam mchog gyur an+tar ba// sgyu lus mthar phyin te lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// mkhas pa'i mchog gyur nā ro pa// bskyed rdzogs mthar son pha na pa// nus pa mchog thob pheng gu pa// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// sngags ston ma rmongs shes rab brtsegs// sgra bsgyur bla ma blo gros grags// gzhan don g.yel med sa chen zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// blo gros phul phyin rtse mo'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dbang grags rgyal dang*// 'jam dbyangs gnyis pa kun dga'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa dang*// rlung la dbang thob bla ma zhang*// snang sems dbang sdud bsod nams dpal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje'i gter chen bsod nams mtshan// rdo rje'i lus brnyes gzungs kyi dpal// rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag dge legs bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje 'chang dbang chos dpal bzang*// skad gnyis smra ba mañju shrī// mthu stobs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan seng*// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gang gi drin gyis legs bskyangs nas// nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// sku bzhi'i lam la sbyor mdzad pa'i// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// ma dag snang ba'i 'khor ba 'dir// skyo shas skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i nyams snang 'di// lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs// dag snang rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di// 'gro bas thob par byin gyis rlobs// snang ba lha ru dag pa'i phyir// bskyed rim brtan par byin gyis rlobs// rang rig rtsa khams rlung sems 'di// 'gros bzhi thim par byin gyis rlobs// chos kun de bzhin nyid du dag

/gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// snang ba gsum dang dag pa gsum// rtogs byed bla ma brgyud pa la// gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig 'phreng 'di// chos dpal smyon pas bris pa yin// dge bas chos 'byung nyams dga' ba// snod bcud lha dang gzhal med khang*// legs rtogs rnal 'byor la gnas nas// rnal 'byor ma dpal 'grub gyur cig /maṅga lam// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim brgyud 'debs bcas bzhugs so// ༈ /rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// gsang mtha'i rgyud gzhung slob bshad gdams pa'i gter// mngon sum 'doms pa drin chen tshar pa rje// snying dbus pad+mar 'bral med bzhugs gsol 'debs// lha mi'i ston pa zla med rdo rje 'chang*// kha sbyor bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mkha' spyod mngon gyur rdo rje dril bu'i zhabs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ro rkyang dbu mar thim pa'i ḍā+eṃ ki pa// gzugs 'dzin gnyis spangs rje btsun an+tar zhabs// bka' bzhi gdams pa'i bcud 'thung te lo pa// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dka' spyad 'ja' lus brnyes pa nā ro'i zhabs// gsang chen zab mo'i bka' bab pham thing pa// skad gnyis smra ba klog skya shes rab brtsegs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gsang mtha'i rgyud 'dzin mal lo blo gros grags// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag sa chen pa// 'od gsal mngon gyur slob dpon rin po che// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyun grags pa'i zhabs// lnga rig 'jam pa'i rdo rje sa skya pa// rtsod dus 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i mtshan// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtan pa'i dkon mchog dpal// phyag chen 'od gsal 'byongs pa'i na bza' pa// gsang spyod mthar phyin bla ma dam pa'i zhabs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rig 'dzin mkha' la spyod pa'i dpal ldan pa// mkha' spyod dbang mos rjes bzung shar chen pa// mkha' spyod lung bstan brnyes pa'i e wam̐ pa// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gsang ba'i mkha' spyod grub pa'i mus chen pa// bam̐ yig gdod ma'i reg mthong bdag chen rje// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i zhal 'doms kun spangs zhabs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// lhan skyes ḍā kis rjes bzung 'jam mgon dpa'// zhing skyes ma mo dbang sdud bla chen tshar// phyi nang mkha' 'gro brnyes pa ma ti'i zhabs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// yongs 'dzin klu dbang gtsug gi nor bur bcings// zab mo'i gnad la rab dga'i phaṭa sgra sgrog

/mkha' spyod gdams pa rgya mtshor rol rtsed mkhan// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor goms las yid kyi lus// dga' ba'i zas can rdzu 'phrul spyod pa'i gar// phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul sku'i zhal 'doms mkhan// rig 'dzin mkha' spyod tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /skye ba bdun pa'i smon lam gnod sbyin mo'i// glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra las mngon sum lus// nam mkha'i gzhal med khang brtsegs rgyas pa'i 'gram// mkha' spyod chung ngu gzhan gyis 'khrid par shog /'chi ba'i 'od gsal dag gam bar do'i 'phrang*// rnam shes 'od lnga 'od gsal ma bu 'dres// mi yul 'dod lha gzugs kyi mkha' spyod sogs// mkha' spyod 'bring du las kyis 'khrid par shog /'od gsal mthu las tshe 'dir rags pa'i lus// 'ja' lus mngon gyur rab dga' dang po'i sa// rnyed la dbang ba mkha' spyod chen po'i lam// bla ma'i drin las g.yel med 'grogs par shog /dhū tī'i dbyings su dga' 'khyil dkar dmar mjal// stong par thim pa bde chen gzugs su langs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mkha' spyod skad cig mar// mngon gyur rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'byongs par shog /dbu ma'i mas snar mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zhabs// ro rkyang dbu mar reg pa rlung sbyor gnad// tshangs pa'i bu gar rdol bas ma spangs lus// dag pa'i mkha' spyod yud kyis bgrod par shog /ces nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa 'di ni/ lam bzang 'di la dad pa'i bshes gnyen dag gis lan mang du bskul ba'i ngor dag pa mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor pa nā gardzu nas chu mo bya'i lo dpyid kyi zla ba la/ mdo g.yag chos sdings kyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod brgyud pa rim gsum la gnas sbyar gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus ku mud kha 'byed byin rlabs chu shel dbang po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gī nī/ gnas rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang du// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i bsti gnas su// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// gnas me tog mdang 'grog gi dgon pa ru// paṇa chen nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bal yul ye rang nyams dga' bar// bal po pham thing pa sku mched la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gar bzhugs dag pa'i zhing khams su// klog skya shes rab brtsegs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gung thang la rtse'i zhing khams su// sgra bsgyur blo gros grags la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sa skya'i gzim khang rnying ma ru// brtse chen kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas chu mig rdzing kha'i yang dben du// slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas las bzhi'i phug chen yangs pa ru// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gzim spyil dkar po'i chos mdzod du// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lha khang bla brang gzim khang du// 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gar bzhugs dag pa mkha' spyod du// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la gsol ba 'debs// gnas na bza' brag phug sgrub khang du// grub chen bsod nams dpal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bsam yas lhun grub pho brang du// bla chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dbus gzhung klu yi dgon pa ru// klu ba seṅge rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'od gsal dag pa mkha' spyod klong*// dbon rgyal ba mchog la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gzhi ga gser khang khra mo ru// yab rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas grom stod kha'u brag rdzong du// bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mgon des byin gyis brlabs pa'i sar// rdo ring kun spangs chen po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas yid 'ong rlung gshongs dga' tshal du// tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// gnas ri khrod rnam grol dgon pa ru// kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mdar stod chos 'khor yang rtse ru// dgon gsar bsod nams chos 'phel la gsol ba 'debs// gnas snying ma dgon gyi chos grwa ru// rje btsun bslab gsum rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas grang chen gsang sngags chos rdzong du// khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas yar klungs bkra shis chos sde ru// mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas zhwa lu ri phug gzim spyil du// rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bco brgyad gzim chung lcang can du// mkhyen rab chos kyi rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dpal ldan rmor gyi dgon pa ru// mkhas dbang kun dga' lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs// gnas snying dbus bde chen pho brang du// gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bzang ldan spu dkar chos rdzong du// mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sa skya'i mkha' spyod pho brang du// sa chen kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dbang khang smin grol bde chen du// 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// gnas chen e wam̐ byang chub 'byung gnas su// sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rgyal khams yangs pa'i do ra ru// bdag po bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gsang sngags bde ldan ri khrod du// bka' spe bstan pa rab rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sgro lung pad+ma 'od snang du// mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gar bzhugs 'og min bde chen du// mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mkha' khyab zung 'jug gzhal yas su// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du// nor skyong dur khrod bdag po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'dod dgu lhun grub gzhal yas su// gnod sbyin pad+ma pa ti la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma'i tshogs// mchog thun mong stsol mdzad yi dam lha// rkyen bar chad kun sel srung ma'i tshogs// bdag snying nas gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs// sa gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// dus ring min thob par byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di dang skye ba thams cad du// yid 'dod don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun// gnas mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ gnas mkha' khyab zung 'jug gzhal yas su// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gnas e wam̐ gnyis med gzhal yas su// rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// gnas nges med dur khrod bas mtha' ru// grub chen nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// gnas phyogs med gdul bya'i zhing khams su// pham thing sku mched zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas chos kun gzigs pa'i pho brang du// klog skya shes rab brtsegs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gung thang bsam gtan khang bu ru// rje btsun blo gros grags la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhugs gnas su// brtse chen kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dag pa mkha' spyod pho brang du// slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po ru// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gar bzhugs sangs rgyas zhing khams su// 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dregs ldan bye ba'i gtsug rgyan du// 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas skye phreng bla brang gzim spyil du// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas na bza' brag phug ri khrod du// grub chen bsod nams dpal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sa skya'i rin sgang bla brang du// 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas tsha rong byang chub 'byung gnas su// chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dag snang 'gag med bzhugs gnas su// shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dpal ldan e wam̐ chos grwa cher// mtshungs med kun dga' bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gling kha dpal gyi dgon pa ru// mus chen sems dpa' chen po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal du// kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mus nang gdul bya'i zhing khams su// 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rin sgang gzim spyil dam pa ru// sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lha chen lhun grub pho brang du// sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dge sdings bsam grub pho brang du// grub mchog bsod nams dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bzhi thog mkha' spyod gzim spyil du// sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol ba 'debs// gnas e wam̐ zung 'jug gzhal yas su// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs// gnas khams gsum zil gnon mgon khang du// 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lha chen nyi 'od 'khyil ba ru// rgyal sras kun dga' bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dad gus tshad med zhing khams su// rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs kun 'dus drin chen chos kyi rje// yongs 'gro ba'i 'dren pa bslu med pa// bzang rim par byon pa thams cad la// bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// snod skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag rnams// lus ma spangs mkha' spyod zhing 'dren pa'i// lha rdo rje btsun mo'i lha tshogs la// bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dpal he ru ka yi spyan snga ru// bstan dam chos skyong ba zhal bzhes pa'i// mgon zhing skyong zung dang nor lha bcas// bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// skye thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// las mi dge ci bgyis mthol lo bshags// deng nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// rje bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog

/ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i gdams pa'i bcud// chos rdo rje theg pa'i snying khu gang*// lam zab mo gsang mtha' la brten nas// bdag ring min mkha' spyod mngon gyur shog /ces nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa rigs gsum la gnas sbyar gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus ku mud kha 'byed byin rlabs chu shel dbang po zhes bya ba 'di ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis kha 'don du brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi bsam gtan khang bu bde chen 'od gsal thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skul ba pos bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun ring por mi thogs par mkha' spyod mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs shig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rten dal 'byor mi rtag dran bskul gyi// las gnyis 'bras so sor nges byas nas// de blang dor 'khrul med goms pa'i mthus// sdig 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /skyabs gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings// sems smon 'jug nor bu'i do shal mdzes// lha rdor sems kyis nyes ltung dri ma 'khrud// rje bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog /yid ngo mtshar phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// gzugs bam̐ yig nang gi btsun mo mchog /sems stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang ngo shes rtse dgas rol par shog /phyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// nang sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// kun zung 'jug gsal stong ting 'dzin gyi// mthong thos rig dag snang 'char ba shog /thabs bskyed rim gsal tshe pho nya mchog /nang rigs ldan mchog dang nyer

bsam mi khyab bsdu ba'i// rtsa dbu mar rlung zhugs ye shes skyes// don ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs dbye shog /khong sgyu mkhan 'khrul 'khor gnad la mkhas// sdig rngon pas srog dbang btsan thabs 'phrog /shing bzo mkhas de gnad dang ldan pa ltar// rten sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod shog /sems rtog dang lus kyi zag par bcas// kun so sor skyed byed rlung sems rnams// mchog dbu mar thim pas mi rtog dang*// lus 'ja' gzugs rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /lam thun che re la thun chung tshang*// grangs sum cu re re 'phel goms mthus// rlung rgyal po dpal ldan kum+bha kas// las ma lus dbu mar 'jug par shog /gnas lte ba rlung gi thig le lnga// yid rtse gcig kha sbyor bsgom pa'i mthus// lus sems rtsar dri gzhon zhugs pa yis// rgyud bde ba mchog gis tshim par shog /lus sems rtsar rlung rnams rim zhugs pa'i// myang tshor ba bde dang mi rtog bde// 'bras mtshon pa'i ye shes legs rtogs nas// de gsal rdzogs rtags bcur 'char bar shog /gnas sprul 'khor las kyi gtum mo dang*// gtsug bde chen 'od kyi gtum mo gnyis// snying ni rma tsakrar 'dres pa'i mthus// lus bde drod ye shes 'bar bar shog /lha rdo rje btsun mo nyi 'bum gzi// de 'od gzugs gangs ri'i phung po las// rgyun mu tig phreng ba 'bar 'dzag gi /ro bde stong dpal la rol par shog /lam ches zab rnal 'byor bcu gcig mthus// dus re zhig dga' ma bye ru'i mdog /skra li grol zur mig mdzes ma yis// bdag mngon sum mkha' spyod khyer bar shog /rdzas sin+dhūr li ya'i sdong bu bcas// gnas ro ldan bsgrubs nas yul kun tu// sems rtog med nyul tshe smin mtshams su// gzugs dga' 'khyil 'phos des rjes 'dzin shog /nang rdo rje phag mos gzung 'dzin bcom// mchog dhū tīr zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// steng mkha' spyod sgo nas sprin lam 'thon// thabs dpal chen sku la dges 'khril shog

/gshis skye 'gags gnas bral gdod ma'i ngo*// ngang stong gsal brjod med gnyug ma'i lugs// don zung 'jug rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo 'phrod rtag tu skyong bar shog /grangs rtsa rlung yongs rdzogs e wam̐ thim// sems bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// gzugs grangs med sprul pa rgya mtsho yis// kun mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces brgyud 'debs gnas sbyar ma le tshan gyi 'dod gsol lam rim du sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba dge/ ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bsdus pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa dang*/ tshar chen gyi mdzad pa'i pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston gnyis kyi kha skong rags rim rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bsdus pa'i kha skong ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang kun dga' bzang po dang*// sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// kun spangs chos rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// tshar chen chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rin chen mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ces pa'i sh+lau ka dang po 'di la mdzad byang ma gsal zhing phyi ma 'di sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che// bsod nams seṅge bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs// sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chos kyi rje// 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po dang*// bzang po dpal ba paṇa chen nam dbang mtshan// rje btsun chos dbang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'di rnams 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad/

yang*/ gnas lnga rig pa kun dga' bsod nams dang*// grub pa'i mchog gyur pu ṇ+ya ī shwa ra// lung rtogs gter mdzod maṅga'i mtshan can dang*// puṇ+ya'i rat+na'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'di kho bos sbyar zhing*/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs ma thob kyang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang thob pas don la 'gal ba med pa 'dra zhing*/ mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kho na'i brgyud pa ni sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can las rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi mas gsan/ de'i zhabs drung du kho bos lan gnyis thob kyang gcig gsal bar dran no// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston gyi zhal skong rag rim phyogs gcig tu brjod na/ rigs sngags 'chang ba sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// rigs kun bdag po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rigs kyi bdag pos rjes bzung ngag gi dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// zhes kha skong 'di'ang lha btsun ngag gi dbang phyug gis bco brgyad lcang lo can du bris pa'o// yang*/ snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bdag po dpal tshul ba// shar chen mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes mtshan// rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po go ram pa// sa bcu'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// grub pa'i dbang phyug lha mchog seṅge dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang po seṅge'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// thugs rje'i gter chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan don grub zhabs// thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i gar gyi dbang*// phun tshogs mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer 'bum 'phro ba// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// de nas/

dal 'byor gru chen sogs dang sbrel/ zhes tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston gyi kha skong ngor lugs kyi brgyud rim 'di 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan 'od zer gyis bskul nas dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o// yang*/ kun bzang bla ma'i snyan brgyud spel ba la/ kun gyi gtsug rgyan tshar chen sprul pa'i gar// kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa// snyan brgyud 'dzin mkhas kun dga' lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bslu med dam pa mang pos rjes bzung zhing*// 'gro kun dga' mdzad snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter// phrin las lhun grub drin chen rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen bla ma yi// snyan brgyud gdams pa zab mo'i mdzod bzung nas// slob bshad bstan pa'i srog shing drin chen rje// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dga' ston 'byed mkhas pa// snyan brgyud mdzod 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// zhes mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ rje rang nyid la sh+lau ka bzhi po 'di ni rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad snyam/ rigs sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan pa// rigs kyi gtso bo rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon rdo rje 'dzin// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// snyan brgyud spel mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' brtsams/

yang*/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs grub pa'i dbang phyug gtso// rgyud don 'chad mkhas bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs// brgyud 'dzin dam pa ngag dbang chos grags la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// zab lam gsal mdzad sngags 'chang kun dga'i mtshan// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// rdo rje snyems bdag maṅga'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// mkhas grub dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// nyams rtogs mnga' bdag bstan pa rab rgyas mtshan// mang thos bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma brag ra rdo rje 'chang gi bka' brtsams/ yang*/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod rmor chen rje// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs// snyan brgyud spel mkhas kun dga' blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// 'di rgyal dbang mchog gi drung yig chen mo skal bzang bde chen sogs kyi zhal 'don du sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bris/ yang*/ grags pa don ldan dpal ldan sa skya pa// grags pa don ldan kun dga' bstan pa spel// grags pa don ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// 'di bdag chen shar pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan gyi gsungs/ yang*/ ji snyed shes bya'i rang zhal mjal ba na// ji bzhin gzigs nas bgrangs yas gdul bya la// ji ltar ston mkhas rje btsun sa skya pa// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// 'di mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang gi gsungs/ shar chen dang mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i kha skong 'di/ kho bos bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi steng nas khrid 'chad skabs/ bong ba gser gzigs kyi bdag rgyan du stsal ba yin no// zhes nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i kha skong rags rim 'di rnams mi thor zhing*/

dpe tshol bde ba'i phyir sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /bde mchog nyung ngu'i lung brgyud gsol 'debs bde chen mngon gyur zhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje 'chang chen gsang ba'i bdag /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub rje// sha wa ri pa lū hi pa// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dha ri ka pa dril bu pa// rus sbal zhabs dang 'bar ba 'dzin// spyod pa'i rdo rje gu h+ya pa// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnam rgyal zhabs dang bar ma'i mtshan// te lo pa dang nā ro pa// pham thing sku mched shes rab brtsegs// mal lo chen po sa chen rje// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo grags pa'i mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa'i zhal// dkon mchog dpal dang bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal tshul ba// ye shes rgyal mtshan ngor chen rje// rat+na war+dha lha mchog mtshan// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dge legs bshes gnyen shar khang pa// thar rtse paṇa chen khu dbon gnyis// bsod nams mchog ldan pad+ma'i mtshan// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ngag dbang rab brtan bud+dha ba// gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// sa chen blo gros mtshan can la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i he ru ka /shes rab sgyu ma'i btsun mo dang*// rol mdzad bde ba chen por 'dud// zung 'jug de nyid ma thob par// rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung ste// mngal sgang rdzus skyes dkyil 'khor du// sbyin bya dbang bzhi'i smin par shog /zab mo'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams// mi nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog

/ma dag skye gnas bzhi sbyang ba'i// gsal dag bskyed rim legs sgom ste// snang ba lha ru 'char ba dang*// zhi sogs phrin las dbang bsgyur shog /rgyud rim gnas lugs shes byas nas// sngags rim gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi// ye shes dga' bzhi'i rim pa bskyed// gsang ba'i rim pa mthar phyin shog /de lta'i rim gnyis la brtson pas// drod thob spyod pa'i mtshams sbyar nas// rab dga' la sogs sa bgrod de// rtse gcig phyag chen grub par shog /khyad par skye ba 'di nyid la// mtshan 'dzin kun rtog rab spangs nas// ḍaṃ gi dha ri ka pa bzhin// gsang chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// nam yang mi 'bral gnas gsum gyi// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan gcig gnas// rig 'dzin dbang po nyid gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu yis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa thob shog /ces dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i lung brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang rang gi go re'i len gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer nas bde mchog nyung ngu'i glegs bam gsar bzhengs rgyun sgrogs byed pa dang chab gcig gsol 'debs 'di bzhin dgos tshul gyi re skong tsam du sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skul ba pos bgyis pa maṅga laṃ// dge'o// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtogs ngag 'don ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/

bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes tshar gcig bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byas la sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis snying gar ai las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi steng du zla ba'i dbus su bam̐/ mtha' skor du oṃ gsum ma'i sngags 'phreng g.yon skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu mnan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag steng du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag rgya dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ye shes gyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ/ khar hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa/ phaiṃ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam phreng bas brgyan// dbu skra nag pos sku sked yan chad khyab// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// snying ga'i chos 'byung sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs nas phag mor gyur// phaiṃ/

rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// 'og min gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis bskor ba// rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de ltar bsgom pa'i lte ba snying ga dang*// kha dang dpral ba spyi gtsug yan lag la// oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ dang*// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis brgyan par gyur// snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags kyis g.yon skor du// bskor las 'od 'phros 'gro drug sdig sgrib sbyangs// 'phags pa'i thugs rje bskul nas snying gar thim// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dag cing gsal bar ci nus bzlas/ bcom ldan mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus kun byang nas// mkha' spyod zhing du khrid par mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba btab/ khams gsum thams cad 'od zhu rang la thim// rang yang mtha' nas rim bzhin bam̐ la thim// de yang mi dmigs bsam mi khyab pa'i ngang*// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal bar gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o// zhes mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad du bsdeb pa dgos zhes mi dbang rtar mdo nas rab brtan phun tshogs kyi bzhed pa dang du blang ste bya bral lhun grub kyis sug bris su btab pa'i yi ge pa ni lhun grub 'jam dpal lo// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /lus dkyil snyan brgyud nyams su len na/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i rjes/ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med 'dres pa yis// bde ba chen pos bdag rgyud byin brlabs pas// bam̐ yig yongs gyur mkha' spyod rigs lnga dang*// sngags phreng rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma dpal gyur// oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs dkyus bzhin dang*/

sngags phreng zla dkyil chos 'byung bcas lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar 'god pa khyad par ro// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad bklags pas myur du grub ces bya ba zab cing byin rlabs che ba khyad par can bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi rol pas kha nub tu phyogs shing*/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs ni/ zhing khams rnam dag bai ḍūr sngon po'i gzhir// gser zhun mig mang ris bres rgya che'i dbus// seṅges btegs pa'i rin chen khri mthon por// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i steng*// rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje chos// dmar gsal mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar longs spyod rdzogs// de yi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rnams// sangs rgyas chos tshogs nor lha chos srung ste// skyabs yul kun 'dus mngon sum bzhugs pa'i mdun// bdag dang pha ma dgra gnyen bar ma yi// 'gro drug sems can ma lus 'khod gyur nas// sgo gsum gus pas snying nas skyabs 'gro bya// bdag dang mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma sangs rgyas dam chos 'phags pa'i tshogs// kun 'dus rdo rje chos la skyabs su mchi// zhes ci nus brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byas la// mar gyur 'gro rnams srid mtsho las sgrol bya// de yi ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// bsgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes ci nus brjod/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang lus tha mal spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sku// dkar gsal mdangs 'tsher zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal// yab kyis phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa yis// yum chen rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin// dbu skra grol ba'i sku la 'khyud pa'i tshul// ral pa'i thor gtsug rigs bdag cod pan can// rdo rje'i skyil krung rus rgyan drug gis mdzes// de yi pang bzhugs shes rab bde skyed ma// bcu drug lo lon phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// pad+ma'i skyil krung dag gis mnyam sbyor bas// dga' bzhi'i bde rgyas 'od snang 'bar ba yi// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig dkar// de las 'od 'phros rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro ma'i// byin rlabs ma lus bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis// bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod// gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs// yab yum sku gang sbyor mtshams las babs pa// rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon nyams chag grib// byang zhing dag nas rang lus bdud rtsis gang*// dbang bzhi thob nas sku bzhi'i dngos grub thob// oṃ shrī badz+ra

dpal rdo rje he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha khrag 'thung nyid kyi nye bar 'go bar mdzod dṛ ḍh+ro me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol su ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod a nu ra k+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag pa shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba sid+dhem+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ tsit+taṃ shre ya ku ru sems la dge legs su mdzod hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung ma me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ bdag po la khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ mahā sa ma ya satwa aḥ dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa' chen po āḥ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pas sdig bsags gang*// ma lus byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs// rdor sems yab yum 'od zhu rang la thim// sgo gsum rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur// zhes brjod/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' seṅges btegs pa yi// rin chen khri steng sna tshogs pad zla la// rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi// g.yas pas bde stong sgra sgrog cang te'u 'khrol// g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis rab gang ba// thugs kar 'dzin zhing rin chen rus rgyan spras// mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis mdzes// mtshan dpe kun rdzogs zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// zhi 'dzum lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' can// snang stong 'od lnga'i klong na gzhon nu'i sku// skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// zhes gsal btab thal mo sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las kun gyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal zhing*// skyabs su mchi 'o bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum sogs gsol ba ci nus btab/

bla ma 'od zhu rang gi spyi bor thim// de yi rkyen gyis snying khar e e las// chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi// steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// dbus su bam̐ yig de mthar g.yon skor du// sngags phreng yig 'bru so gnyis dmar pos bskor// de las 'od 'phros lus kyi nang gang bas// lus ngag yid gsum gzhi yi sdig sgrib sbyangs// rang lus 'od phung dmar po'i gong bur zhu// de nyid yongs gyur rang sems rnal 'byor mar// gyur pa sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo// gri thod 'dzin pa'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan// zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed mdog nag po// gri thod cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa// stag sham gyon pa'i mgo bo rgyab bltab mnan// sku mdog dmar mo bskal me'i 'od lta bu// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mkha' spyod gzigs// phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug thur brkyang 'dzin// g.yon pas thod pa khrag gang steng phyogs su// bzung nas bzhad zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ gar// ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'phan rtse gsum// dar dpyangs 'phyang ba bsnams shing gcer bu'i sku// lang tsho bcu drug lon nyams nu 'bur rgyas// 'dod pa'i bde ba bskyed pa'i chags nyams 'bar// dbu skra nag po sil bus sku sked khyab// mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// thod skam lnga bcu'i 'phreng mdzes phyag rgya lngas// brgyan cing bla ma rnam snang rigs bdag can// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// bde chen snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku// de yi lte ba snying ga zhal dpral ba// spyi gtsug tshigs chen brgyad du zla gdan re'i// lte bar oṃ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo dmar// snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma// ljags steng hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo// dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma// spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu// tshigs brgyad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsan+ḍi ka

/chu zla bzhin du go cha'i lha sngags gsal// thugs kar chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng sgom// de las 'od 'phros ba spu'i sgo nas 'phros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus// khams gsum snod bcud ma lus thams cad khyab// ma dag gzhi yi snang ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs// snod kyi 'jigs rten 'od snang gzhal yas khang*// bcud kyi sems can rdo rje phag mo'i sku// bde stong zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i ngang*// snod bcud gdod nas dag pa'i lha ru gsal// 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ phaiṃ/ thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer dpag med 'phros// 'og min zhing dang gnas yul dur khrod brgyad// phyogs bcu'i gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// 'gro kun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khams gang ba// char sprin ltar 'dus rang la sib kyis thim// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med mchog tu gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcings mnyes par bsams/ de nas pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod la/ nga rgyal bzung*/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar// nyis brtsegs zur bsnol nang du zla dkyil dbus// bam̐ la sngags phreng dmar pos g.yon du bskor// grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar skya g.yon du 'khyil// dran pas bde bskyed ye shes rang 'od 'tsher// de las 'od 'phros sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rnal 'byor mar bkod sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod// byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer dmar po yi// rnam par spyan drangs sngags phreng mchog la thim// bdag rgyud byin rlabs dngos grub myur thob gyur// zhes bsams/ phreng ba byin gyis brlabs pa bzung la/

oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas/ de nas rlung ro bsal la rlung bum can 'dzin zhing*/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor bzung ba'i yid bzlas dang*/ yang rang gi smin mtshams dang gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyar bzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis mthar snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam la/ mnyam par 'jog pa sogs rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa sogs bla ma'i man ngag las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin mnyam bzhag spro ba chen pos ci nus sgom/ rjes thun mtshams kyi lhar langs la go cha srung 'khor/ gsol 'debs smon lam sogs la 'jug rdzogs rim rnams rgyas pa mi nus pa'am ma shes na rjes bsdu/ bsam mi khyab bsgom pa gsal 'debs ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad khyab// gzugs med khams pa 'od zer sngon por zhu// rang nyid lha sku'i stod kyi cha la thim// gzugs khams snod bcud 'od zer dmar por zhu// sku sked bar gyi cha la thim par gyur// 'dod khams brtan g.yo 'od zer dkar por zhu// lha sku'i smad char thim zhing lha sku yang*// stod smad nas bzung rim bzhin 'od du zhu// thugs ka'i chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng la// de yang bam̐ la bam̐ yang mi dmigs pa'i// dus gsum rtog bral chos dbyings bde ba che// gsal stong zung 'jug smra bsam brjod las 'das// bsam gyis mi khyab phyag chen ngang du bzhag

/de las skad cig chu las chu bur bzhin// gzugs sku rnal 'byor ma yi sku ru bzhengs// zhes brjod cing bsams nas/ de yi lte ba snying ga zhal dpral ba/ nas/ chu zla bzhin du go cha'i lha sngags gsal// zhes pa'i bar sngar gyi go cha bkod cing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan bi d+ya rā dza ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs srung ba phyag len bzhin byas mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus kun byang nas// mkha' spyod zhing du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo sil snyan sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces dang*/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs bya'o// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*// rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' 'bangs pa// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis// rang dang skal mnyam rnams la phan phyir bris// nyes par gyur na mkha' 'gros bzod par bzhes// dge des mkha' spyod go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog rnal 'byor mar// gus btud nas ni de nyid kyi// sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde ba// mkha' spyod lam bzang bri bar bya// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len mdor bsdus ni/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/ skyabs yul rang la thim/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rdor sems he ru ka sku mdog dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'phros pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad rnag khrag dud khu'i rnam pas phyir thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis khengs par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍh+ro me wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre ya ku ru hūm̐ḥ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wā na badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca/ badz+ra he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ thal mo sbyar la/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

rdor sems yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ nang mchod dngos sam med nas bsam kyang rung la/ lag pa g.yas pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yon pa bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ mthe bong dang gung mdzub sbyar/ de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis bsnol ba mdzub mo gnyis kyis bzung*/ mthe chung gnyis rtse sbyar ba'i phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi len tshul myong tshul byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i bam̐ yig la mchod par bsam/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po/ cang te'u thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma rin po ches bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang zla steng bam̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lus sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur brkyang dang*/ g.yon thod khrag steng du bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā dril 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan do shal rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi nu ma dang dpral ba nas mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten chos 'byung gzhal yas khang dang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/

phaiṃ/ zhes dang*/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo sbrel/ mtheb gung gnyis so sor rtse sbyar/ lhag ma 'bar ba ltar byas pas dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing*/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes dang*/ phyag gnyis khu tshur thugs kar bsnol ba lan gsum/ rang gi lte ba/ snying khar/ lce steng*/ dpral ba/ spyi gtsug yan lag rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ dmar sngo dkar ser ljang gu dud kha'i mdog rnams gsal bar gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig la sogs pa dam bca' bzhin rgyun 'don dang*/ bsnyen pa'i tshe 'bum bzhi'am 'bru 'bum phyag len la mdzad/ bzlas pa rdzogs rjes/ rang gi snying ga'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas lte bar babs te/ de'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams la sems gtad/ ces dang*/ rlung bum can bzung la yid bzlas ji ltar rigs pa byed/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste/ de yang gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs la thim/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa rim gyis 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ hoṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lag g.yon sdig mdzub phyogs bcur bstan zhing bsrung ba bya ba ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni zhes pas shar dang*/ sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis steng*/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byang*/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya nub dang*/ grih+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis 'og oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bi d+ya rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis lho/ de bzhin du sngags gong mtshungs las shar lho nas bzung ste mtshams bzhir sdig mdzub g.yas bskor du lan gcig bskor/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa/ oṃ gsum ma lan gcig dang*/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dag go /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo'i sgra snyan glu dbyangs sogs brjod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gis// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rgyal kun yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs kyi bkra shis kyi mtha' brten par bya'o// de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde bklag chog ma 'di yang lha lcam bde ldan sgrol ma'i rgyun gyi zhal 'don du sgrub thabs nyung bsdus shig dgos zhes bskul ma gnang bar brten sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'pho ba lhan cig tu bkod pa tshar chen gsung gi snying khu 'chi med 'bras ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra wā ra hī/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i ngag 'don gyi tshul ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes tshar gcig bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/

sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs nas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo// snying khar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/
zhes brjod/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du 'khor ba las 'od zer

dmar po dpag med 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas/ rlung kha sbyar ci thub 'dzin/ rang gi smin mtshams dang gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyar bzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis snying ga'i bam̐ la thim par bsam mo// rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum thams cad la khyab/ gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin du zhu bas chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la/ de sngags phreng la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de bam̐ gyi mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de je phra je phra mi dmigs par gyur/ ces pas brjod bral du ci gnas bzhag de yi ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur pa'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam rtse mo je sbom la song ba dung gi gsham kha lta bu tshangs bug la gtad de skar khung skya thal le yod pa'i dbu ma'i mas snar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis bkag pa'i steng du rang gi sems nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/

zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin nam/ yang na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs ji lta ba 'phar la khad pa gar stabs kyis ling ling bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod kyang rung*/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma zla ba 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong ba mnan pa'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin du bskor nas bzhugs pa'i bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'chugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa dang mnyam du sems kyi bsam pa ni/ bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la phog pas rang sems rje btsun mar gsal ba rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas gyen la bya 'phur ba bzhin gshegs te tshangs bug nas bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs kar zhes brjod pa'am ma brjod kyang rung*/

thim par bsam la rig pa 'dzin med du 'jog sems 'phro na steng rlung rngubs pa dang mnyam du rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs ka nas thon/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du byon par bsam la rlung kha sbyar ci thub 'dzin/ ma thub na sna nas dal bus btang la/ yang*/ 'og rlung bskyod pa sogs gong gi dmigs pa yar 'pho ba dang mar 'bebs pa tshar bdun nam gsum la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa byas pa'i rjes su/ mtha' skor na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams 'od du zhu nas bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la thim/ de'i gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas sku la thim/ sku je chung je chung la song ba mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam rang gi tshangs bug nas rtsa dbu ma'i nang la zhugs snying ga'i thad du byon par gyur/ zhes brjod pa'am ma brjod kyang rung*/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i spyan lte ba'i rang sems rje btsun ma la gzigs/ rje btsun mas he ru ka la yar gzigs pas bde stong gi ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsam pa'i dmigs pa ji ltar rigs pa byas pa'i mthar/ rang gi tshangs bug gi skar khung 'od dmar po sra zhing 'thas pa la 'od zer sna tshogs las grub pa'i rdo rje rgya gram gyis kha bcad pas bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi 'phig par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// 'di ni sbyang ba yin la/ las sbyor gyi tshe rang sems bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la thim nas/ de dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig la mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam la rig pa brjod med du 'jog pa'o// yang rje btsun yum rkyang gi 'pho ba bsgom par 'dod na/ bsam mi khyab las lang pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra la/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur pa'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar la rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam rtse mo je sbom la song ba dung gi gsham kha lta bu tshangs bug la gtad de skar khung skya thal le yod pa'i dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa dbu ma dang dbyer med pa'i zur gsum lte ba dang mkhal khung gnyis la bstan rtse mo gsang gnas su zug pa'i nang du rang gi sems nyid bam̐ yig dmar po ril ma tsam 'phur la khad pa dang*/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma zla ba 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor te 'ja' gur gyi dbus na me tog gi char 'bebs/ 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug cing spos kyi dri zhim po 'thul ba la sogs pa mkha' spyod dngos dang mtshungs par gyur/ zhes brjod la rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad sems kyis mchod par phul bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par sogs/ gong bzhin gsol ba btab la/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pas bam̐ yig dbu ma'i nang nas gyen la thal gyis song ste tshangs bug nas thon bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam la sems 'dzin med du bzhag yang steng rlung rngubs pa dang mnyam du bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas rang sems bam̐ yig thon/ tshangs bug dang dbu ma'i lam nas zhugs te chos 'byung gi nang du byon par bsam la rlung kha sbyar 'dzin/ mi thub na sna nas btang*/ yang 'og gi dmigs pa bskyar la gsum la sogs pa byas pa'i mthar/ rang sems bam̐ yig lte bar byon bla ma rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ 'od dang sna tshogs rdo rje gong bzhin gsal btab pa ni sbyang ba'o// las sbyor gyi tshe nges pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba na dam tshig gso ba'i phyir sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs bla ma la zhu ba'am/

rang gis bdag 'jug blangs/ dngos po rnams spang dag byas la gang la yang zhen chags med par man ngag 'di nyams su blangs te rang sems bam̐ yig bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs kar thim ma thag rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par bsam la dbyings rig bsre'o// rgyun gyi nyams len la spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i rjes su/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo sil snyan sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces brjod/ thun mtshams su gtor ma phul bar 'dod pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa chen por sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ phaiṃ/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas mthar se gol gtog cing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba 'di yis man chad brjod/

badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// zhes tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'pho ba'i man ngag lhan cig tu bkod pa 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos nyams len pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas bkod pa yin pas 'di bzhin du nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams kyi mkha' spyod ma'i mngon rtogs ni rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal phyir yig cha gsar rnying ga nas nyams su blangs kyang 'gal ba med par sems pas de bzhin bya'o// zhes pa'i yi ge pa ni gso 'dzin bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gzhan la 'chi khar 'pho ba 'debs tshul lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ gzhan la 'chi khar 'pho ba 'debs tshul rje btsun yum la brten pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsung rgyun zin bris bklag chog tu bkod pa ni/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas byed mus yin na de'i nga rgyal dang*/ thun mtshams gzhan gyi rnal 'byor pa yin na mkha' spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas nyung du zhig blangs la bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar ram bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor bsgom tshar ba'i rjes su/ dmigs yul de la snying brtse ba'i bsam pas 'di skad ces gdams par bya ste/ 'o tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba nyon cig khyed rang tshe 'di'i snang ba nub nas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku na yod pa yin pas/ de la brten nas grub mtha' rnyogs pa'i phyir 'chi srid 'khrul pa'i snang ba la sems ma yengs par kho bos 'pho ba gsal 'debs pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du sgoms shig khyed rang pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod khrag gyen du 'phyar nas gsol ba/
